name: centerfuse
description: CenterFuse parent platform and product ecosystem.

scripts.build:packages: npm run build -w @centerfuse/config && npm run build -w @centerfuse/database && npm run build -w @centerfuse/ui
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:packages && tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm test && npm run build
